overview.title: It is not a run. It is a challenge.
body: Mala cena Velke Verandy is a traditional forest cross in the heart of the Chocen woods. In just 4300 meters you get everything that makes trail racing memorable: steep climbs, technical descents, and roots underfoot.
The short distance tempts you to underestimate it. The profile corrects that quickly. This is a race with character for hobby runners and seasoned racers alike.

Admin.clubMergeIntro: A club is its id in the club list: a renamed club stays one club and its names per edition are its history. Some clubs have more than one id, though (e.g. a registration created a new record instead of reusing the old one). Below are suggested pairs of different ids based on the similarity of their names. Nothing is merged automatically: for every merge choose which id stays the main one and check in the preview how many rows change. A merge rewrites the data: entries, start lists and results of the merged id get the main id and the merged id disappears from the club list. A merge is IRREVERSIBLE; the full state before the merge is stored in the audit log for a manual repair.

Guide.title: How to enter MCVV
Guide.description: Video guide and step-by-step instructions: creating an account, entering, quick add of runners from previous years and paying the entry fee.
Guide.lead: Entering on mcvv.org step by step – a short video first, then a detailed guide with screenshots. The website itself is in Czech; button labels are shown in Czech with an English translation.

steps.title: Open mcvv.org
steps.text: Click Přihlásit se (Sign in) in the top right corner.

steps.title: Sign in or create an account
steps.text: If you already have an account on the new website, enter your e-mail and password. Otherwise click Založit účet (Create account).
steps.tip: Accounts from the old website no longer work – please create a new one.

steps.title: Create an account
steps.text: Fill in your name, e-mail and password (twice). The club is optional. Or choose Pokračovat přes Google (Continue with Google) – no password or verification e-mail needed.
steps.tip: Use the e-mail you registered with in previous years – you will see your earlier entries and can add their runners with one click.

steps.title: Check your e-mail
steps.text: We have sent you a verification link. It is valid for 24 hours.

steps.title: Verify your e-mail
steps.text: In the e-mail “Ověření e-mailu — MCVV” click Ověřit e-mail (Verify e-mail).
steps.tip: Can’t find it? Check your spam folder.

steps.title: You are signed in
steps.text: After signing in you always land on Moje přihláška (My entry). You can rename the entry, e.g. to your club or family name – confirm with Uložit (Save).

steps.title: Add a new runner
steps.text: Fill in surname, first name, year of birth and sex. The category is suggested from the year of birth and the club is prefilled from the entry name. Click Přidat (Add) and the runner appears in the table.

steps.title: Quick add – runners from previous years
steps.text: Rychlá nabídka (Quick add) lists all runners you entered from this e-mail in previous years. Just click them – category and fee are filled in automatically.
steps.tip: Entering a club? Rename the entry to the club name and save it first. Runners get their club from the entry name.

steps.title: Pay the entry fee
steps.text: The Platba (Payment) section shows the amount, account number, variable symbol and a QR code for your banking app.
steps.tip: The entry becomes valid and appears in the list of registered runners only after payment.

steps.title: Edit until the deadline
steps.text: You can change the club or list of runners until the entry deadline. Confirm header changes with Uložit (Save).

steps.title: Next time
steps.text: Next time just sign in with e-mail and password (or Google) – you are taken straight to Moje přihláška (My entry).

steps.title: Forgotten password
steps.text: On the sign-in page click Zapomněli jste heslo? (Forgot password?), enter your e-mail and we will send you a link to set a new password (valid for 1 hour).

faq.q: Can I use my account from the old website?
faq.a: No. The new website has new accounts. Create a new one – ideally with the same e-mail you used for earlier entries, so you can add runners from previous years in Quick add with one click.

faq.q: I did not receive the verification e-mail.
faq.a: Check your spam folder. The link is valid for 24 hours. If you try to sign in with an unverified account, the website offers to resend it.

faq.q: I am entering several people (family, club).
faq.a: One account is enough. Add any number of runners to one entry; fees are summed and paid in one payment with one variable symbol. For a club, rename the entry to the club name first.
Only after the entry fee has been paid. Only then do the runners appear in the list of registered runners.
Yes, until the online entry deadline you can edit details and add or remove runners.

faq.q: I sign in with Google – do I need a password?
faq.a: No. If you want to set a password as well, use “Forgot password?”.

LiveSplits.clearIntro: After a dry run, deletes the splits (mcvv_split) and their journal including conflicts. A snapshot of the deleted times is stored in the audit log. Results (mcvv_time), records and the start list are not touched.
LiveSplits.clearAllowedUntil: Allowed until race zero ({zero}). After that only single corrections.
LiveSplits.clearBlocked: Bulk clearing is disabled from race zero ({zero}) on. Correct single times in the split editor.

saved.unchanged: No change – the time is already stored.

LiveSplits.unknownBib: The bib is not in this edition's start list. Saving requires “save anyway”.

TestRun.active: Test run in progress – zero {zero}, automatic end {expires}.

TestRun.zeroLocked: During a test run the zero is held by the test.
TestRun.banner: TEST – test run, zero {zero}, ends {expires}. Data are deleted afterwards and are not public.
TestRun.leftovers: WARNING: test data remain on race day – splits: {splits}, starts: {starts}{zero}{run}. Delete them before the start (Year splits – clear, Start check).
